messages:
sara: perf alert — mixtral hotshot route p99 jumped ~2.5x after kernel switch. saw on canary 03/02 @ 02:14 UTC. anyone else?
matt: I saw traces. repro locally with small load. sending perf profile.
nana: attaching flamegraph + short trace. looks like router softfill kernel spends more time handling sparse topk.
nana:   https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/profiles/3076543210-flame.svg
kevin: can you paste the kernel config you rolled? I suspect the softmax-temp tweak we merged.
sara: rolled commit 8b3f7a — changed kernel selector to prefer "softfill-v2" when estimated batch > 8
matt: repro command:
```
perfctl profile --targets=router,kv --duration=30s --out=./out.svg
curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" -d '{"model":"mixtral-3b-moex","prompt":"<hotshot>"}'
```
julie: noted. initial hypothesis: increased batch threshold + softfill-v2 => more topk post-processing on-device, raising p99.
nana: also seeing KV cache eviction bursts coincident with the spike. eviction_rate ~0.18 -> 0.46 /min on affected hosts.
kevin: where are those evictions coming from? rope scaling mismatch?
nana: maybe. model config on the canary shows rope_scale:1.10 while runtime kernel expects 1.0. also head_dim mismatch: model head_dim:64 vs runtime assumed 64 but kv stride changed due to quant layout.
sara: here's the runtime batch & kv config we used on canary:
```
{"dynamic_batch_threshold":16, "batch_pad_ms":8, "kv_cache_policy":"lru_v2", "expert_cache_size":4096}
```
matt: suggestion: try lowering dynamic_batch_threshold to 8 and disable softfill-v2 for router selector.
julie: and try top_k routing change? top_k currently 6 on canary.
kevin: lowering top_k to 3 reduces router compute and evictions in sim. but increases misroute rate by ~0.7% on unit tests.
nana: misroute rate small but client p50 unaffected, p99 drops. tradeoff probably worth for hotshot paths.
sara: ok can someone run a micro-canary with:
```
runtime.overrides={
  "router.kernel":"softfill-v1",
  "dynamic_batch_threshold":8,
  "router.top_k":3,
  "expert_parallelism":2,
  "expert_cache_size":2048
}
```
matt: I'll run it on two nodes and attach perf. also will pin kernel selection to use kernel heuristics scoring that includes kv_eviction_penalty.
deploy-bot: deploy canary started by @matt — canary id c-8791 — 2 hosts — expected finish 10m.
nana: after 5m metrics: p99 down ~28%, eviction_rate back to 0.12, but expert CPU imbalance increased on host-2.
kevin: expert_parallelism=2 may be stressing the single NIC; try reducing expert shard size or move experts to host-3.
julie: also check RoPE linear interp. if rope_scale != runtime, kv keys mismatch and eviction churn spikes.
sara: good catch. I'll add an assert in model loader to validate rope_scale header vs runtime config to fail fast.
matt: follow-up tests: with softfill-v1 + top_k=3 + expert_parallelism=2 we see stable p99 on canary for 20m. planning rollback of kernel selector change.
nana: also opened perf issue #PI-1421 with traces and config diffs.
sara: thanks team. action items: matt rollback selector change, add rope_scale assert, run broader canary with varied head_dim (32/64) matrix, tune expert_cache_size per workload. I'll own coordination with oncall.
julie: :thumbsup:
sara: closing thread when rollback done. ping me on @sara if you need help.
